g.text: Archive generator: shared gain/noise model; pooled null and separate PRE/POST templates
Thin lines: individual recordings. Solid lines: sample means. Dashed lines: generating templates.
Statistical tests average the 3 recordings assigned to each artificial subject; the two null samples are independently generated.
